title: Chromatic Fiber Structure at Bad Primes
exact_target: At primes p that are bad relative to chromatic level n, give a plausible systematic description of the homotopy type of $\Sigma F_n$, where $F_n$ is the common fiber in the chromatic splitting square for the p-local sphere.
